event_chain.summary: Privilege escalation, vulnerability exploitation, data exfiltration
Ransomware encrypts cargo, scheduling and customs systems

summary: In December 2025 the Anubis ransomware group compromised the Adriatic Port Authority (Port of Ancona, Italy), according to a Resecurity report. The attackers gained initial access through spear-phishing, escalated privileges and exploited unpatched vulnerabilities, then encrypted systems supporting cargo tracking, shipping schedules and customs processing and exfiltrated contracts, safety plans, employee records and internal communications. They demanded $10 million in bitcoin and publicly claimed the attack in January 2026, releasing stolen data. The disruption affected maritime logistics in the region.
